plan.title: Live RFQ withdrawal blocked during submission

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects required for the prepared RFQ.
Configure the tenant to remove Withdraw from event menus.
Apply the setting under test so withdrawal is blocked while bidding is open.
Apply the additional case configuration for the live RFQ screen.
Open the RFQ stage specified by the case.
Open the Responses tab where the case examines the live RFQ.
Confirm the Responses screen rendered before checking its event actions.
Assert that the live RFQ Settings menu does not offer Withdraw under the configured restrictions.
